lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ኦ ጐይታ ውዕለትካ ተኣምርካ ድንቂ’ዩ
ኣምላኻዊ ቃልካ ስምካ ሕይወት ኢዩ /2/
[[/chorus]]

ብሐዋርያት ጌርካ ብዙሕ ምሂርካኒ
[[highlight]]ስለ ኃጢአተይ ሞይትካ ሕይወት’ውን ሂብካኒ /2/[[/highlight]]

ኣጸናኒዕካኒ በጺሕካ ኣብ ሓዘነይ
ኣጆኻ ዝወደይ ኢልካ ዘልዓልካኒ
ኣጆኺ ’ዛ ጓለይ ኢልካ ዘልዓልካኒ

ካብ ዘይጠፍእ ሓዊ ካብ ሞት ዘውጻኻኒ
[[highlight]]ንዓኻ ዝኸፍሎ ጐይታ እንታይ ኣሎኒ/2/[[/highlight]]

ሓቀኛ ረዳኢ ወገነይ ንስኻ
[[highlight]]ጐይታ ካብ ወለደይ ትበልጽ ንስኻ /2/[[/highlight]]

ምእመናን ንምካሕ ጐይታ ብኣኻ’ዩ
[[highlight]]ዘይትቕየር ኣምላኽ ስምካ ክቡር'ዩ/2/[[/highlight]]

ስምካ መግበይ ኮይኑ እጸግብ ጸዊዐ
[[highlight]]ፍጹም’ውን ይምካሕ ፍቕርኻ ጥዒመ /2/[[/highlight]]

ብሰማይ ብምድሪ ብነፍሲ ብስጋ
[[highlight]]ብኣኻ እምካሕ ኣልፋ ወኦሜጋ /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
ʾO goyta wiʿiletka teʾamrika dinqi’yu
ʾAmlakhawi qalka simka hiywet ʾiyu /2/
[[/chorus]]

Bihawaryat gerka bizuh mihirkani
[[highlight]]Sile hat'iʾatey moytika hiywet’win hibkani /2/[[/highlight]]

ʾAtsenaniʿikani betsihka ʾab hazeney
ʾAjokha ziwedey ʾilka zelʿalkani
ʾAjokhi ’za gwaley ʾilka zelʿalkani

Kab zeyt'efʾi hawi kab mot zewtsakhani
[[highlight]]Niʿakha zikheflo goyta ʾintay ʾaloni/2/[[/highlight]]

Haqenya redaʾi wegeney niskha
[[highlight]]Goyta kab weledey tibelts niskha /2/[[/highlight]]

Miʾimenan nimkah goyta biʾakha’yu
[[highlight]]Zeytiqhyer ʾamlakh simka kibur'yu/2/[[/highlight]]

Simka megbey koynu ʾitsegb tsewiʿa
[[highlight]]Fitsum’win yimkah fiqhrikha t'iʿime /2/[[/highlight]]

Bisemay bimdiri binefsi bisga
[[highlight]]Biʾakha ʾimkah ʾalfa weʾomega /2/[[/highlight]]
